LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASS: COLLECTIVE NOUNS/ REFLEXIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: How do you emphasise that you did something on your own? 2. Which words do you use to refer to a group of things or animals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
•Communication and collaboration: team work as the learner works in pairs or groups to identify reflexive pronouns and collective nouns from print

and digital texts..

•Digital Literacy: interacting with digital devices as learners watch a signed video clip in which collective nouns and reflexive pronouns have been

used in sentences.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as learners answers questions and create crossword puzzles in pairs.

Link to other Subjects:

Learners are able to relate the knowledge of Word Classes such as Collective Nouns, Reflexive Pronouns to their learning in Kiswahili.
